notes: Colby, 2026-09-07 22:30: DECIDED pixel art. Animate four of the five Meshy pixel scenes (not the party) as first frames on Seedance 2.0 and on Veo 3.1 (the second model most likely to hold hard pixel edges at 1080p), 1080p, for a side-by-side.

The explorer tiptoes forward across the rope bridge, arms out, cane held for balance; behind him the planks snap and tumble one by one into the misty gorge, dust puffing, the ropes swaying; his eyes go wider.
